title: Initialize the video
explanation: For the video's construction alone, super(title, trace) records the validated base title before the video constructor records its duration. Both constructors initialize one video object. These events are inspected after construction returns.

title: Use inherited behavior
explanation: Assigning video to resource copies its reference. The runtime object remains an InheritanceVideo; getTitle is inherited from InheritanceResource. The private title state is initialized and read by base-class code.

title: Dispatch the same instance call
explanation: present accepts InheritanceResource in both calls. A plain resource uses the base describe implementation. The video uses its override, which explicitly reuses super.describe before adding its duration.

title: Compose a playlist
explanation: The playlist stores a resource reference and delegates describeNext to that object. It does not extend InheritanceResource. The same video can still be referenced elsewhere; this has-a example makes no exclusive-ownership or lifetime guarantee.
